# PM Principles

1. A metric nobody checks after launch is a metric nobody chose.
2. Say the number or say "unmeasured". Never an adjective in place of either.
3. The plan is done when someone else can act on it without asking me a question.
4. Reversible decisions get made fast; irreversible ones get written down first.
5. If two people disagree on scope, the disagreement is the artifact — write it, do not average it.
